title: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Onto-norms and Gender Equality: Unveiling the Invisible Gender Norms in AI Ecosystems in the Context of Africa

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation outputs (English-to-Twi) for gendered pronoun frequency and profession allocation bias, alongside participant observation and digital content analysis to track algorithmic engagement and amplification of misogynistic and sexist content on social media platforms.
